title: Chords: The Final Countdown with the band

blocks.text:
A **chord** is three or more notes played together. The Final Countdown's riff sits over four chords, and all four are the same shape in your hand.

**By the end** you can play A minor, F, D minor and G, change between them in time, and accompany the band.
# Warm up: the riff from the music

# One shape, four places
Take every other white key: a note, skip one, a note, skip one, a note. With your left hand, fingers **5 3 1**. That shape is a **triad**. Start it on A and it is **A minor** (A C E); on F it is **F** (F A C); on D it is **D minor** (D F A); on G it is **G** (G B D). The letter it starts on names the chord.

In the song each chord lasts two bars: **Am, F, Dm, G**.

blocks.title: The four chords, by name
blocks.about: Twelve cards: a name comes up, you play it.
blocks.doneWhen: 10 of the 12 cards clean in one set

blocks.title: The chords in time
blocks.about: Eight cards of four bars: one chord a bar, on the click.

blocks.text:
# With the band
Drums and bass play the song's chords; you play each chord on beat 1. The band keeps going, so look at the next chord before the bar ends. *Show me first* plays a round for you.

blocks.title: The Final Countdown with the band
blocks.about: Accompaniment lab: chords on the beat.

blocks.text:
# If this happens
- **The three notes don't sound together.** Find all three keys first, then press.
- **You're late for the change.** Read the next chord on beat 3.

**Until the next lesson:** the chords with the band each day.
